mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_images (comment_id, image_url, image_order, created_at) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageOrder}, NOW())

insert.foreach: INSERT INTO comment_images (comment_id, image_url, image_order, created_at) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{imageUrl}, #{index}, NOW())

mapper.select: SELECT image_id, comment_id, image_url, image_order, created_at FROM comment_images WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} ORDER BY image_order ASC
